# px4-params.json

PX4 parameter metadata (name / shortDesc / longDesc / min / max / units / type /
default / group), used by the parameter editor to show units, help text, and to
validate edits against each param's range. MAVLink does not carry this metadata on
the wire — only name/value/type — so it is bundled here and matched to live params
by name.

**Provenance:** generated by the PX4 firmware build, copied from
`mojave-px4/build/px4_sitl_default/parameters.json` (branch `mojave/sim-v1.16.2`).
Regenerate by rebuilding PX4 and re-copying when the firmware's params change.
